subject: AetherGrid — final dedicated sizing needs and request to place soft-escrow hold
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AetherGrid final sizing ask — quick availability sweep

Chloe / Marcus,

Quick note on AetherGrid — they sign off on product requirements this morning and want a final confirmation on dedicated capacity sizing before legal pushes the contract to signature. Highlights:
- Production target: 95th pct 60ms p99 inference, 1,200 concurrent sessions steady-state.
- Model: ensemble of two 30B decoder models (KV cache heavy), approx 3500 token windows on spikes.
- Target go-live: first week of Nov; first 3 months expected steady growth.

From the sizing work Ben + SEs did, we're looking at roughly: 8 x A100-80GB equiv (or equivalent quantized fleet mix) to meet latency + redundancy, with room to burst to 12 for onboarding ramp. I attached the current sizing workbook (v0.3) — that lays out the performance assumptions.

Ask:
1) Marcus — can you run an availability sweep for US-west and US-east, call out which nodes we can earmark for a 21-day soft-escrow / provisional hold and any pre-reqs (hold fee, PO, legal countersign)? Please include exact node types (GPU counts), serial mapping, and impact to other commitments.
2) Chloe — I'll sync with procurement in parallel; would like you to prepare a short note for leadership if we need a temporary hold fee credit to close.

Attachments: aethergrid_prod_sizing_v0.3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 245KB stub)

Thanks — we need a go/no-go on placing a soft-hold by EOD Wed so we don't lose runway.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AetherGrid final sizing ask — quick availability sweep

Ben / Chloe —

See inventory snapshot attached. High-level findings for US region (quick summary):
- US-West (primary cluster): 12 nodes currently free that map to A100-80GB equiv (after considering thermal binning). Reservable immediately: up to 8 nodes without breaking current reserved pools.
- US-East: 4 nodes free; to reach 8 additional we'd need to re-balance (2–3 day ops change window) or borrow from a short-term soft-pool.
- Global burst headroom (spot-like) available but not acceptable for low-p99 latency SLAs.

Constraints / Notes:
- A 21-day soft-escrow hold is operationally feasible in US-West. We tag nodes with a soft-hold id and prevent autoscaler from placing new tenants there. Hold requires: internal capacity buy-in + a PO or signed LOI from customer that includes soft-hold terms.
- If AetherGrid wants cross-region redundancy we should earmark 2 nodes in US-East (adds ~18% margin).
- Impacts: holding 8 nodes in US-West reduces general burst capacity for the upcoming internal Q4 performance test window by ~9%. Ops recommends we surface this to leadership (Naomi) for a targeted exception.

Proposed soft-hold package:
- Soft-hold id: SOFTHOLD-AG-408
- Duration: 21 days (extendable to 45 days with senior approval)
- Minimum acknowledgement requested: LOI or PO referencing SOFTHOLD-AG-408

Attachments: fleet_inventory_snapshot_20260914.csv (inventory export, 88KB stub)

Let me know if you want the raw node serials now or after legal confirms LOI language.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Capacity Planner, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: AetherGrid final sizing ask — request to approve temporary soft-hold

Naomi — forwarding the thread + Marcus's inventory snapshot. TL;DR: we can reserve 8 A100-80GB equiv in US-West under a 21-day soft-hold (SOFTHOLD-AG-408) while AetherGrid completes procurement. Ops flags ~9% impact to Q4 burst capacity.

Background for decision:
- Why hold? AetherGrid is at final signature milestone; procurement has asked us to secure capacity so their launch date won't slip.
- What we need from leadership: approve SOFTHOLD-AG-408 and either (a) accept a nominal hold fee (recommended) or (b) allow a limited credit for a strategic deal.

Proposed ask: Approve the soft-hold and allow Chloe to agree to a single-month credit equal to 10% of estimated first-month usage if needed to close (Ben has pricing options). If yes, I'll instruct Marcus to tag nodes and I'll send the external hold acknowledgement to Samir (AetherGrid) with the DocuSign SOW link.

Attachments / links: HubSpot deal / drive SOW in thread.

—Chloe

Chloe / Marcus —

Approve the soft-hold as described (SOFTHOLD-AG-408) for 21 days. I agree that this is strategic; AetherGrid's use case maps well to our real-time reference set. Conditions:
1) Attach a nominal hold fee of $8,000 for the 21-day window (Finance to record as deferred revenue if collected). If AetherGrid pushes back, authorize Chloe to apply a one-time 10% first-month usage credit instead (document in HubSpot).
2) Marcus — tag the nodes and provide the serials in a follow-up Ops email to both internal and the customer once we have an LOI/PO.
3) Legal: Ben/Chloe — please include the soft-hold clause number and the hold id in the SOW addendum; route via DocuSign.

Thanks — move forward and loop me if procurement stalls.

—Naomi

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Soft-hold confirmation (SOFTHOLD-AG-408) and next steps

Samir / AetherGrid procurement team —

Thanks for the productive discussions earlier this week. Per our internal approvals, Redwood is able to place a 21-day provisional soft-escrow on dedicated capacity in US-West to support your Nov launch. Summary: 
- Hold id: SOFTHOLD-AG-408
- Capacity reserved: 8 x A100-80GB equiv (node serials to follow once LOI/PO received)
- Duration: 21 days (window expires 2026-10-07 unless extended via mutual agreement)
- Soft-hold fee: $8,000 (or, by mutual agreement, we can apply a 10% first-month usage credit instead).

Next steps for you:
1) Please send a short LOI or PO referencing SOFTHOLD-AG-408.
2) Sign the SOW addendum sent through DocuSign here: https://www.docusign.com/AG-408-SOW

I've attached a soft-hold acknowledgement stub for your records. Marcus will share exact node serials after we receive your LOI/PO and DocuSigned SOW.

Attachments: soft_hold_acknowledgement.pdf (PDF stub, 14KB)

If you'd like a call to review the node mapping or the failover plan, Ben and I are available tomorrow morning PT.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
